reporting.v_case_session_totals.definition: SELECT c.id AS case_id, c.case_number, c.person_id, count(s.id) FILTER (WHERE s.session_status::text = 'completed'::text) AS completed_sessions, max(s.started_at) FILTER (WHERE s.session_status::text = 'completed'::text) AS last_completed_session_at FROM care.case_file c LEFT JOIN care.session_record s ON s.case_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.case_number, c.person_id
reporting.v_case_session_totals.name: v_case_session_totals

iam.v_effective_permission.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ar.account_id, p.code AS permission_code FROM iam.account_role ar JOIN iam.account a ON a.id = ar.account_id JOIN iam.role r ON r.id = ar.role_id JOIN iam.role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN iam.permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE a.account_status::text = 'active'::text AND r.active AND p.active AND ar.revoked_at IS NULL AND rp.revoked_at IS NULL
iam.v_effective_permission.name: v_effective_permission

reporting.v_monthly_sessions.definition: SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, (s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/La_Paz'::text))::date AS month_local, s.professional_account_id, c.service_type_id, count(*) AS completed_sessions FROM care.session_record s JOIN care.case_file c ON c.id = s.case_id WHERE s.session_status::text = 'completed'::text GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, (s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/La_Paz'::text))::date), s.professional_account_id, c.service_type_id
reporting.v_monthly_sessions.name: v_monthly_sessions

reporting.v_practicum_approved_hours.definition: SELECT p.id AS placement_id, p.student_person_id, COALESCE(sum(EXTRACT(epoch FROM a.ended_at - a.started_at) / 3600.0) FILTER (WHERE a.approval_status::text = 'approved'::text), 0::numeric)::numeric(12,2) AS approved_hours FROM practicum.placement p LEFT JOIN practicum.activity_log a ON a.placement_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.student_person_id
reporting.v_practicum_approved_hours.name: v_practicum_approved_hours

reporting.v_practicum_recorded_hours.definition: SELECT p.id AS placement_id,p.student_person_id,floor(COALESCE(sum(extract(epoch FROM (l.ended_at-l.started_at))) FILTER(WHERE l.voided_at IS NULL AND l.ended_at IS NOT NULL),0))::bigint AS total_seconds FROM practicum.placement p LEFT JOIN practicum.activity_log l ON l.placement_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id,p.student_person_id
reporting.v_practicum_recorded_hours.name: v_practicum_recorded_hours
